notes: Federal Register PDF exactly as served by govinfo (4 pages, Federal Register pages 106231-106234, three text columns per page). Reading order: page 1 starts with the masthead and the boxed section note in column 1, then column 1, column 2, column 3; tables span the full width between column blocks. Several must_contain phrases deliberately cross a column boundary on the same page: 'revisions to the / fee structure' (page 1, column 2 to column 3), '$317.50 inspection fee will be / determined' (page 2, column 1 to column 2 below Table 1) and 'subject / to such actions' (page 2, column 1 to column 2 at the foot of the page). No phrase crosses a page boundary. Line-end hyphens are written joined: '40,000-pound' and 'per-pound' are true compounds and keep their hyphen (both are printed unbroken elsewhere in the document); the absent entries are the split forms a converter leaves when it keeps a line-end hyphen and joins the lines with a space, listed only where the joined word is one unhyphenated word on the page ('in- spection' and 'Agricul- tural' in the Table 1 and Table 3 footnotes, 'Destina- tion' in the redesignation table on page 4). Every line-end hyphen in the body text of this document falls inside a true compound ('per-pound', '40,000-pound'), so no body-text split form is listed as absent. Headings are the document title (the SUBJECT line) plus the section headings and the CFR part and section headings of the amendatory text; the agency, sub-agency, CFR, docket and RIN lines of the preamble are bold labels and are not listed. The two section-symbol headings are given without the leading '§'/'§§' because the text layer has no space after the section sign while the page shows a thin space; each listed string is an exact substring of the printed heading. In '51.39 through 51.62 [Redesignated as' the page shows a wide space before '[', which the text layer encodes as an 8-point positioning gap with no space character. Table captions are not headings. Jkt 265001 ... 30DER1', set horizontally along the bottom edge in white), which exists in the text layer of all 4 pages but is not visible on the rendered page, so a faithful conversion has 0; max 1 is used as the lenient running-header/footer limit, and 'Jkt 265001' is used instead of 'VerDate Sep<11>2014' because converters may escape the angle brackets. A second invisible slug, 'ddrumheller on DSK120RN23PROD with RULES1', is set rotated (also in white) in the left margin; it is not checked because extractors emit rotated text inconsistently (forwards, reversed or split), so a count would penalize only the converters that read it forwards.
